problem: The single-report PDF never stated the run's CI verdict or its rating. summary.certificate was read only as a gate (src/output/pdf/single_report.rs), and verdict/verdict_reasons were not rendered at all — the SummaryBlock field named `verdict` is a narrative prose sentence, a different value that happens to share the name. The cover's band phrase was derived from the score alone and therefore contradicted the verdict. Separately, both shipped runs were audit_quality=partial while presenting their rating as settled, with the only scope caveat in the methodology appendix at line ~6960 of ~7000.
evidence: reports/inros-lackner-audit.* generated 2026-09-19 (auditmysite v1.5.0): JSON verdict "fail" with reasons ["legal_flags: 5", "blocking_issues: 36"], summary.certificate "NICHT BESTANDEN", grade F, audit_quality.status "partial". The CLI printed "FAIL — legal_flags: 5, blocking_issues: 36" and report-lint validated the certificate, but the strings "NICHT BESTANDEN", "legal_flags" and "blocking" each occurred zero times in the rendered .typ. The cover instead read band_phrase "Ausbaufähiger technischer Zustand" — a clear softening for a failing run with five legal flags. casoon-audit was the mirror case: verdict "warn", rating "SEHR GUT", audit_quality "partial", and nothing on the cover or management page said the run was incomplete.
expected: The PDF states the same verdict the CLI prints and the JSON publishes, in a management-summary block labelled "Gesamteinstufung" / "Overall rating" — not "Zertifikat": calculate_certificate maps the overall score onto a band label and certifies nothing, in a document that cites BFSG and EN 301 549. A failing run says so on the cover, and a run that did not complete is marked provisional on the cover and in that block, not only in the appendix. The reasons are rendered from VerdictReasonKind in the run language; the canonical machine strings ("legal_flags: 5") stay in VerdictResult::reasons for the JSON and CLI and are never shown to a reader (#406). The provisional reason is omitted from the reason list when the provisional sentence already carries it, so the same fact is not stated twice.
counter_examples: A passing, complete run must not be marked provisional and must keep its score-derived cover phrase — the correction only fires for fail (cover) and for partial (provisional marker).
VerdictResult::reasons must keep its exact current strings: it is the JSON contract and what CI consumers parse. reason_kinds is #[serde(skip)] so the JSON gains no second source for the same fact.
The batch path deliberately leaves reason_kinds empty — the batch PDF does not render reasons, and the batch-specific ones (failed URLs, average score) would need their own variants.
